n1.text:
BLM notes
• Header and search field follow the BLM Design System (Header / Status=DK, Search / Type=Contextual): Inter, #111 / #767676 / #CBCBCB.
• On this board the sparkles replays the tip for review; in the flow, a click anywhere on the search (sparkles included) opens the search modal below.
• Placeholder cycles BLM-specific queries and scrolls on one line, never wraps or truncates.

n2.text:
Search modal (BLMHW Sprint 2, Desktop)
• The whole search (icon, field and sparkles) is one target: a click anywhere opens the modal over the header. Focus goes to the field.
• Search box: #F9F9F9, 72px, “Search the way you’d describe it”, 24px search + 24px close (no sparkles in the box).
• One grid for every state: 3 equal columns, 32px gaps (Figma Desktop), so nothing shifts while typing.
  – Empty field: Contextual search explainer + Try examples | Designers | Your recent searches (+ Clear All), or Trending if no history
  – Typing (suggestions): Designers | Results + Show All Results | Your recent searches (Trending if no history). Product results are hidden.
  – No results: Designers | “Sorry, there are no results for …” | Your recent searches.
• Preview: toggle “hasHistory”, “noResults” and “startOnResults” (opens straight on the results page) in Tweaks; typing keyboard mash (e.g. asdasdasd) also triggers no results.
• Dummy live search: Results and Designers filter from a sample catalogue as you type; the typed words or letters are highlighted in magenta (#FA16C8, per Figma; 3.4:1 on white, below AA for 16px). Clicking a Try example shows a “Goes to results page” tooltip. Try “a black bag for evening”, “dress”, “sne” or “gucci”.
• Clicking a result, designer, recent or trending search, Show All Results, or pressing Enter closes the modal and opens the results page (BLMHW Sprint 2 › Results Page): “Search results for “…””, Filter + Recommended sort, 4-column product grid, You’ve viewed / Load More.
• Contextual search on the results page:
  – “We searched for”: the query broken into what we understood (Colour Black · Occasion Evening · Category Bags, plus Designer, Material, For him/her, Budget, Offer). Each chip can be removed; the title, count and products update. The last chip can’t be removed.
  – “Refine your search” (#F9F9F9 bar, animated sparkles): 4 contextual follow-up searches built from the same understanding (e.g. Black evening clutches, Black bags under AED 2,000, Saint Laurent black bags, Heels to match). Each one runs a new search.
  – Results load with a short skeleton; products are sample data, prices respect a budget (“under AED 1,000”) and “on sale” shows sale pricing.
• Clicking the header search on the results page reopens the modal with the query filled in. Product, Filter and Sort clicks show a stand-in tooltip. Enter on a no-results query shows “Goes to the no results page”.
• Overlay: 70% black; ×, Esc or clicking it closes (animated) and clears the query.

n3.text:
Mobile search (BLMHW Sprint 2, Mobile)
• Homepage header (BLM Design System): search icon + 16px sparkles as one tap target; first-visit tip (340px, “NEW • CONTEXTUAL SEARCH … Got It”) fades in after load and goes for good after Got It or opening search.
• Tap the search: the search sheet drops over the header (same 200ms open/close as desktop), focus goes to the field, 16px text so iOS doesn’t zoom.
• Search box: #F9F9F9, 20px padding, 20px search + close icons.
• Sections stack in one column, same logic as desktop:
  – Empty field: Contextual search explainer + Try examples → Your recent searches (Trending if no history)
  – Typing: Results (live highlight) → Designers → Your recent searches
  – No results: “Sorry, there are no results for …” → Designers → Your recent searches
• Try examples show a “Goes to results page” tooltip.
• Results, designers, recent and trending taps, Show All Results and Enter open the mobile results page (Sprint 2 › Results Page, Mobile): title, “We searched for” chips and a “Refine your search” chip row (both scroll sideways), Filter / Recommended bar, 2-column grid, Load More. Same contextual logic as desktop.
• Long content scrolls inside the sheet; the 70% overlay fills any space below it.
• Tweaks: startOpen, showTip, hasHistory, noResults, startOnResults. Device status bar and Safari bar from the Figma are left out.
